illustration.description: Flat vector cartoon illustration in clean navy outlines, front view of a person's lower legs and feet standing side by side. Both legs wear slim dark navy (#1F3A68-ish) trousers with subtle fold shading, ending in rolled cuffs just above the ankles. Exposed skin ankles in soft peach tone, short white crew socks, and white low-top leather sneakers with navy outlines, light gray side panels, visible laces and thin white soles. A soft pale lavender-gray elliptical ground shadow sits beneath the shoes. Plain white background, even soft lighting, friendly minimal editorial style.
